---
name: "nf-core/bam_markduplicates_samtools"
description: "Samtools markduplicate SAM/BAM/CRAM file"
keywords:
- "markdup"
- "bam"
- "sam"
- "cram"
components:
- "samtools/collate"
- "samtools/fixmate"
- "samtools/sort"
- "samtools/markdup"
input:
- ch_bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM/CRAM/SAM file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,cram,sam}"
- ch_fasta_fai:
    type: "file"
    description: "FASTA file and its index.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta2), path(fasta),\
      \ path(fai) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,fai}"
output:
- bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Sorted and markduplicate BAM/CRAM/SAM file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,cram,sam}"
authors:
- "@priyanka-surana"
maintainers:
- "@priyanka-surana"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/samtools/collate@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/samtools/fixmate@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/samtools/sort@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/samtools/markdup@0.0.0-6d1763b"
